generated.details: On the mid-plane left tabletop, partly cropped at frame left, the plain unlabelled document storage box has a low rectangular cream paperboard body and a separate fitted lid with a shallow overlapping rim.
Beside its right end, clear of the laptop, the palm-sized gray stone paperweight is one solid rounded piece with a flattened underside resting on the tabletop.
On the far-plane left wall, the vertical wood-slat feature consists of evenly spaced oak strips secured to a recessed backing, with narrow shadow gaps.
